description: Build configuration and script for UEFI EDK2 Firmware targeting Arm platforms, including environment setup, build steps, and deployment instructions.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures build environment, modifies tools_def.template with target system info.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the firmware using build system, applies patches to makefiles, copies configuration templates, and runs make.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built firmware binary into the designated directory.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: Deploys firmware images to deployment directory.
